title: Top Navigation Prototype
text: Use core helper already using dash_titles(): dash_topnav_options() bundles top-nav settings one object. can still use individual topnav_* arguments use_bs4Dashkit_core() small one-overrides, object form keeps production setup easier scan. align controls mirrored tabs sit navbar: "left" keeps tabs close brand usually safest choice navbar also centered dash_nav_title(). "center" centers tab group works best centered title short tabs. "right" moves tab group toward right controls, useful brand visually heavy left side needs space. gap controls space top-nav items. Use small value 4 6 subtle breathing room, 0 compact AdminLTE-style tab strip.
code: ttl <- dash_titles(   brand_text = "Topnav Lab",   icon = icon("compass"),   collapsed = "icon-only",   expanded = "icon-text" )  body <- bs4DashBody(   use_bs4Dashkit_core(     ttl,     preset = "professional",     layout = "topnav",     topnav = dash_topnav_options(       align = "left",       gap = 6,       mobile = "collapse",       style = "compact",       title = "auto"     )   ),   bs4TabItems(     bs4TabItem(tabName = "overview", "Overview"),     bs4TabItem(tabName = "reports", "Reports")   ) )

title: Top Navigation Prototype
text: default, mobile top-nav mode uses hamburger button tabs: Use mobile = "scroll" prefer single horizontally scrollable row small screens. Mobile top-nav modes work best without centered navbar title viewport starts tighten; keep title = "auto" bs4Dashkit hides dash_nav_title() early tab row needs room, set title = "hide" permanently tab-first navbar. topnav_style controls tab treatment: underline style uses small animated indicator moves active tab changes. crowded desktop navbars, move later tabs dropdown: title = "auto" compacts centered dash_nav_title() tabs need room, hides still enough space. Use "show", "compact", "hide" want explicit behavior. Top-nav clicks also emit Shiny event: page body needs simple title synced active tab, enable: can also call use_dash_topnav() directly assemble dependencies :
